extracted.intended_audience: Patent practitioners or attorneys seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; counsel and parties involved in Office of Enrollment and Discipline proceedings
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural requirements and decision process for a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline. Covers filing a petition, supporting affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, submission of supporting evidence, and agency review/decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: A Petition for Reinstatement must be submitted (the document references a Petition for Reinstatement of Jeffrey K. Seto received on March 25, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision demonstrates that a formal petition is the initiating submission for seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: The petitioner filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit complying with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is required or expected to accompany the petition; the decision cites that regulation as the basis for the supporting affidavit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementation with supporting evidence and documents
rubrics_metrics.description: The Petition was supplemented with other evidence and documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Petitions should be supported by additional evidence and documentary materials demonstrating eligibility for reinstatement; the Office will consider such supporting materials in its review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative review of petition, affidavit, and record information
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director conducted a careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision process involves examination of the petition, statutory/regulatory affidavit, and any relevant record information; petitions are evaluated on the basis of the entire record material to eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director authority to grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: After review, the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline determined that reinstatement was appropriate and granted the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director (Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline and Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline) has authority to determine and order reinstatement based on the record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice/Service of decision to petitioner
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of the decision was sent to the petitioner at a physical address and an email address is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decisions are served to the registrant; ensure accurate contact information (mailing address and email) is provided so that the petitioner receives notice of the outcome.
